references.text: God's covenant with Abram, where He promises to give the land to his descendants, from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates.
God promises to give Abraham and his offspring the entire land of Canaan as an eternal possession.
God sets the boundaries for the promised land and promises to deliver its inhabitants into their hands.
God promises to give the Israelites a land flowing with milk and honey.
Moses commands the people to go in and take possession of the land that the Lord has promised to their fathers.
Command to drive out the Canaanite peoples when they enter the land.
Israel shall cross the Jordan to drive out nations greater and stronger than them.
Israel shall take possession of the land when they cross the Jordan.
God commands Joshua to lead the people into the land He is giving them.
The fulfillment of the promise: The Lord gave Israel all the land He had promised their fathers.
The psalmist reminds that God drove out the peoples and planted Israel in the land.
God gave them the land of the nations so that they might keep His statutes.
